name: 星星魔法和女巫STAR MAGIC AND WITCHES
detailed_description:
Story Overview

In an era where sword and sorcery intertwine, a mysterious continent thrives with diverse races—humans, elves, merfolk, and more—living side by side. Ancient legends and forgotten secrets await the brave who dare to uncover them.

Your journey begins in a magical town, home to a long-established academy where young sorcerers gather to study the theories and techniques of magic, engaging in both lectures and hands-on experiments.

  • During the school term: Students devote themselves to mastering spells, magical theory, and practical applications through structured classes and experiments.

  • During summer and winter breaks: Once the term ends, students are free to leave the academy and explore the vast continent. Whether investigating ancient ruins, braving treacherous dungeons, or helping villagers solve difficult problems, these breaks offer valuable opportunities to grow and gain experience.

Every choice you make will shape the path of your story. Balance learning with adventure, uncover the secrets hidden deep within the continent, and write your own legendary tale.

Since she can remember, Dashi has lived in a tower, accompanied by a cursed, magic-wielding mouse.
And so, the story begins the day Dashi steps outside the tower for the very first time…

Exploration & Gameplay

This is a 2D adventure game centered on map exploration and turn-based combat.

  • Build relationships with characters and unlock unique side quests;

  • Unravel the mysteries of the world through both battles and exploration;

  • Discover deeper character connections and piece together the truth behind key events.

Art Style

  • Features hand-drawn 2D visuals with selectively crafted frame-by-frame animations;

  • Utilizes a unique top-down perspective that breaks away from traditional 2D norms;

  • A wide variety of beautifully illustrated CGs can be unlocked through different interactions.

About the Game

  • Enjoy heartwarming daily moments with your companions;

  • Engage in classic turn-based combat that rewards strategic thinking;

  • Freely explore the world through a mini-map and intuitive area transitions.

supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core Duo E6600 @ 2.4GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel 4400, GeForce GT 8800, AMD Radeon HD 4650
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any PC with sound
  • Additional Notes: any normal pc can play.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400s @ 2.5 GHz or AMD FX-6350 @ 3.9 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD R9 280X
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any PC with sound
  • Additional Notes: any normal pc can play.
